notes.title: Join The Community!
notes.content:
Like our game?
Then head on over to our discord server: https://discord.gg/xfHr3SJ

If you have no one to play with then our discord server is perfect for you, Just join and ask if anyone would like to play with you!

I am a very friendly developer and would love your personal feedback!

notes.title: 2 New Halloween Creatures On The Way!
notes.content:
We are currently working on 2 new creatures, 

A Ghost creature called Spooks

And a zombie like creature called AArrg

notes.title: NEW HALLOWEEN CREATURE!
notes.content:

Meet Pat, Our brand new creature!

notes.title: EARLY BIRD SPECIAL + 40% LAUNCH DISCOUNT!
notes.content: For the first 24 hours of release "Little World Of Creatures" will have a rare limited time creature called "Free". If you purchase this creature with in the first 24 hours of release it will be permanently added to your "Little World Of Creatures" account.
